limitations: The public archive does not contain the original per-player deal or terminal hands. Remaining card counts are inferred from the declared 20/28-card allocation and each seat's recorded plays; they are not a captured terminal hand snapshot.

Unique physical cards and canonical-deck coverage do not independently establish the original ownership of every unplayed card. Initial ownership and policy information boundaries are additionally covered by local implementation tests.
This is one observed production hand, not evidence that learning improves win rate or that the new arena has completed a 24-hour availability test.
